tools.name: sanitize_html
tools.description: Cleans untrusted HTML before it is stored on a comment thread. Comment nodes such as <!-- tracking pixel --> are removed, <script> and <style> elements are dropped entirely, and every surviving attribute is checked against the allow-list in policy.json.

mode.description: strip-comments keeps formatting tags and removes comment nodes; ignore-scripts additionally drops event-handler attributes; text-only returns the plain text content.

tools.name: preview_sanitized
tools.description: Returns a diff between the submitted HTML and the sanitized output so a moderator can see which nodes, comments and attributes were removed.
